name: crime_effect_cone
description: Test 11. Occupant inserted (0x99EF1142) / removed (0x99EF1143): an occupant with property 0xCA5B9306 = {m, r} adds AddRadiusEffect<uint8>(effect grid, centre = PositionToTract(pos), radius = r / S tracts, centre value +-m, outer 0). {100, 8}, S = 2 -> radius 4, k = f32((100 - 0)/4) = 25. Position (257, 0, 257) -> tract (8, 8) (32 world units per tract). Per simgrid 7.1 with foundations 18 (t = f32(d x k), v = f32(c - t), then rhe; d from the 3-decimal table for R < 16): d = 0 -> 100; 1 -> 75; 1.414 -> 64.65 -> 65; 2 -> 50; 2.236 -> 44.1 -> 44; 2.828 -> 29.3 -> 29; 3 -> 25; 3.162 -> 20.95 -> 21; 3.606 -> 9.85 -> 10; d >= 4 (4, 4.123, 4.243) unchanged (strict d < radius). Preview occupants (0x029244DB) are skipped; [choice] a 1-byte property is skipped. Removal subtracts the same cone and clamps: with the centre set to 30 every cell returns to 0. Three inserts saturate the centre at 255 (300), so one removal leaves 155, not 200: insert/remove pairs do not always restore the grid. Values from an independent Python model of simgrid 7.1.
